topics.title: The Fundamental Accounting Equation (Assets = Liabilities + Equity)
topics.objective: Understand the balance sheet equilibrium and how transactions affect economic resources and claims.
topics.exercise: Record the balance sheet impact of 5 business transactions (capital contribution, loan, purchase).

topics.title: Double-Entry Bookkeeping: Debits & Credits
topics.objective: Master the rules of debits and credits across Asset, Expense, Liability, Equity, and Revenue accounts.
topics.exercise: Draft 10 journal entries for a startup service business covering sales, rent, and utility expenses.

topics.title: General Ledger Posting & Unadjusted Trial Balance
topics.objective: Post journal entries to T-accounts and compile a balanced trial balance verifying total debits equal total credits.
topics.exercise: Post a month of journal entries to ledger accounts and construct an unadjusted trial balance.

topics.title: Accrual vs. Cash Accounting & Adjusting Entries
topics.objective: Record period-end adjustments for accrued revenue, accrued expenses, unearned revenue, and depreciation.
topics.example: Debit Depreciation Expense $500; Credit Accumulated Depreciation $500
topics.exercise: Prepare end-of-month adjusting entries for prepaid rent and accrued employee payroll.

topics.title: Financial Statements Preparation (Income Statement & Balance Sheet)
topics.objective: Synthesize adjusted trial balances into clean Income Statements and Classified Balance Sheets.
topics.example: Net Income = Revenues - Expenses; Ending Retained Earnings = Beginning + Net Income - Dividends
topics.exercise: Compile a complete Income Statement and Balance Sheet from an adjusted trial balance.
